verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
OMPULIRE Kitaffe
Ggwe Mukuumi wange:
Beera kumpi nange;
Onjijanjabenga.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Ayi Mukaama Yesu,
Atuwa-obulamu,
Ka nziruke-embiro
Okutuuka gy'oli.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Ggwe Mubeezi waffe,
Mwoyo wa Katonda,
Laba bwe nkwetaaga
Nsembeza, nnongoosa.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Jjangu, Ayi Katonda;
Tondekanga wano,
Okuva kaakano,
Tuula mu nda yange.
